subject: ClearWave POC: credential checkpoints, SSO invites, and API access
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Green <sam.green@clearwave.health>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-01-18T17:12:00Z
Subject: ClearWave POC: credential checkpoints, SSO invites, and API access

Hi Sam —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap + proposed credential gating so we can hit your evaluation window next week. Main asks from our side are lightweight but important to keep the trial secure and reproducible.

POC goal (as discussed): validate Redwood inference latency/cost for patient-record redaction and clinician-assist prompts on a 10k-message sample, and confirm integration with your SSO and audit log requirements.

Proposed credential checkpoints and owners:
- Week 0 (today–Jan 20): SSO invites sent; test login + SCIM provisioning validated. Owner: Rachel
- Week 1 (Jan 21–27): API key and sandbox endpoint provisioned; IP allowlist applied. Owner: Monica
- Week 2 (Jan 28–Feb 3): Run 10K sample, collection of latency/cost metrics and a short quality eval. Owner: Ben

Success criteria (minimum):
- 95th percentile inference latency < 200ms for median prompt size
- End-to-end redaction precision >= 98% on the curated set
- No blocked requests from your network (SSO + IP allowlist validated)

Access notes / immediate next steps we need from ClearWave:
1) Confirm SSO domain for invites (email domain you want invited) and SCIM attributes you expect.
2) Provide IP ranges to add to our sandbox allowlist (or confirm you’ll use the SSO-only path).
3) Sign the trial Addendum (I’ll attach the one-page doc).

Attachments: I’ve attached a one-page checklist (ClearWave_POC_Success_Checkpoints.xlsx) and a short quickstart for the sandbox API.

If that looks right I’ll send the SSO invites and spin up a sandbox API key that expires automatically after the trial.

Thanks —

Rachel Kim
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
[rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com]
[Attachment: ClearWave_POC_Success_Checkpoints.xlsx (12KB)]
[Attachment: redwood-poc-api-quickstart.pdf (78KB)]

From: Sam Green <sam.green@clearwave.health>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: A. Morales <amorales@clearwave.health>
Date: 2027-01-18T19:05:00Z
Subject: Re: ClearWave POC: credential checkpoints, SSO invites, and API access

Thanks Rachel — solid plan. A couple clarifications from our side:

- SSO domain: clearwave.health (please invite users at @clearwave.health). We want SCIM attributes: givenName, familyName, email, title, and employeeId.
- IP ranges: our infra team prefers we use SSO-only for auth, but they will still provide a /24 for the sandbox if you need it: 198.51.100.0/24.
- Trial Addendum: please send the one-page and I’ll route to procurement; should be fine.

Two small asks: can the sandbox API keys be rotated automatically every 30 days and can you surface request audit-ids so we can map them to our logs? Also, do you have a brief SOC2 artifact checklist we can use to speed up security review?

Sam
Sam Green, Head of Data Platform
ClearWave Health
[sam.green@clearwave.health]

Sam — thanks, answers below and next steps included.

Short answers:
- SSO invites: will send invites to @clearwave.health and enable SCIM with the attributes you listed. I’ll include Monica from infra on the SCIM mapping call.
- IP allowlist: we’ll add 198.51.100.0/24 to the sandbox environment; you can opt to rely on SSO-only for production mapping.
- API key rotation: sandbox keys can be auto-rotated every 30 days. We’ll issue an initial key that expires after 90 days for the trial but can enable 30-day rotation on request.
- Audit IDs: every request includes a request_id header; we’ll point you at the mapping dashboard.
- SOC2 artifact checklist: attaching a short checklist and giving you a link to our security portal for the SOC2 report redactions.

Proposed immediate actions (I’ll take these today):
1) Send SSO invites and SCIM invite link (expect email invites within 2 hours). Owner: Rachel
2) Provision sandbox API key tied to the ClearWave test org and apply the 198.51.100.0/24 allowlist. Owner: Monica
3) Share SOC2 checklist and a link to the redacted report in the security portal. Owner: Rachel

Would you like a short 30-min technical walkthrough after SSO provisioning to validate session behavior and SCIM sync? We can do that Thursday morning.

Thanks —

Rachel
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
